ALLERGY HISTORY:
Aspirin (anaphylaxis).
Patient is not taking Ibuprofen 400 mg PO daily.

Drug History:
Previously received Allopurinol 100 mg PO daily last year.

Discontinued Medications:
Warfarin 5 mg PO once daily was stopped.
Completed a course of Amoxicillin 500 mg PO three times daily for 5 days.
Start Acyclovir 400 mg PO twice daily if vesicles recur.
Patient education: Aspirin can cause bleeding; this is an educational example.
Differential treatment options: consider Midostaurin 50 mg PO twice daily.
Withheld Apixaban 5 mg PO twice daily pending review.

Current Medications:
Levofloxacin 500 mg PO once daily.
Continue Metformin 500 mg, 1 tablet PO twice daily.
Started Meropenem 1 g IV every 8 hours for 10 days.
It is unclear whether the patient takes Acyclovir.

Family History:
Mother takes Warfarin 5 mg daily.
Avoid Ibuprofen because of renal impairment.
Patient denies Aspirin allergy.

Chemotherapy Regimen:
Cytarabine 100 mg/m2 continuous IV infusion + Daunorubicin 60 mg/m2 IV push.
Start Acyclovir 400 mg PO twice daily and start Meropenem 1 g IV every 8 hours for 10 days.

Current Medications:
Metformin 500 mg, 1 tablet PO twice daily.
Acyclovir.
Give Acyclovir 100 mg/mL solution, administer 5 mL IV every 8 hours.
Start Meropenem 20 mg/kg IV every 8 hours.

Start Vincristine 1 mg IV.
Withhold Vinblastine.
Continue Glycomet GP 1 tablet PO daily.
Start Acetaminophen 500 mg, 1 tablet PO once daily.

Medication Orders:
Zorvaximab 2 mg/kg IV weekly.
Occupational exposure to benzene and ethanol was discussed. Serum sodium 140 mmol/L.
CT is the initials of the technician. The patient lives in PO district.
Report to Day Care Oncology Wing on 01/12/2026 at 09:00 AM for CBC.

Follow-Up Plan:
Report on 01/12/2026 for CBC and renal function tests.
CBC performed yesterday showed thrombocytopenia.
Bone marrow biopsy was performed yesterday.

Prior Investigations:
MRI performed last year.
Repeat CBC if fever persists.
No repeat CT scan required.
Plan for bone marrow aspirate next week.
Order flow cytometry today.
It is unclear whether cytogenetics was performed.

Investigations Performed:
Bone marrow aspirate and bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML. Blood cultures grew E. coli. Cytogenetics showed a normal karyotype.
Obtain renal function panel, liver function panel, serum electrolytes, and serum uric acid tomorrow.
Check full blood count, hemoglobin, platelet count, differential count and peripheral smear.
Order urine culture, culture and sensitivity, stool antigen testing and molecular mutation testing.
Order chest radiograph, ultrasound abdomen, CT chest, MRI brain, ECG, echocardiography and spirometry.
Check serum creatinine, blood glucose, HbA1c, lipid profile and CRP.

Medication Orders:
Start Ondansetron 8 mg PO SOS for nausea from 01/12/2026 until 03/12/2026.

Allopurinol 100 mg daily.
2. DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
Acyclovir 400 mg PO BD.
3. FOLLOW-UP INSTRUCTIONS:
CBC next week.
